title: Instant CoinGlass 7D coverage for dynamically added Pionex PERP custom symbols
changes: On each new custom PERP symbol, immediately resolve any already decoded real CoinGlass 7D levels and show them without waiting for candle-history loading.
Trigger an immediate coalesced full-market CoinGlass 7D refresh after custom additions, reusing the existing six-version local decoder and existing transport.
Support exact custom CoinGlass symbols and tokenized-stock trailing-X aliases (e.g. GOOGLX to GOOGL); support 1000-lot scale for custom symbols with the existing rule.
Preserve the fixed crypto/stock lists, separate dynamic custom list, CoinGlass-only policy, RR rules, prices, daily indicators, four chart windows and alerts.
Do not add browser extensions, bookmark workflows, new APIs, Worker changes or proxy liquidation zones.
requiredDeploy: Overwrite four frontend files in the same GitHub Pages directory. No Cloudflare Worker or other project changes.
limitation: A custom ticker absent from the genuine CoinGlass 7D market response cannot be given a fabricated liquidation boundary.
